definitions.explanation: Something done or prepared immediately without advance planning. Used both for physical products (instant food) and for actions done spontaneously (impromptu speeches, offhand performances).

examples.japanese: {即席|そくせき}ラーメンを{食|た}べた。
{即席|そくせき}のスピーチを{頼|たの}まれた。
examples.english: I was asked to give an impromptu speech.

examples.japanese: {残|のこ}り{物|もの}で{即席|そくせき}の{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}ったが、{意外|いがい}と{美味|おい}しかった。
examples.english: I made an impromptu dish from leftovers, and it turned out surprisingly good.

notes:
Functions as a noun modifier using の: {即席|そくせき}の～. Very commonly associated with instant food products, especially {即席|そくせき}めん (instant noodles).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{即席|そくせき}めん — instant noodles
・{即席|そくせき}ラーメン — instant ramen
・{即席|そくせき}の{演奏|えんそう} — impromptu performance
・{即席|そくせき}で{作|つく}る — to make on the spot
